metadata.notes: Blocking classes fail only on repository-wide net increases. Report-only classes are counted for visibility and never fail this ratchet. Blocking counts were driven to zero and the report-only counts were re-measured on 2026-08-11 by the ai-slop debt burn-down (tasks/archive/2026-08-10-ai-slop-debt-burndown.md); the new report-only floor represents the sanctioned non-boundary cast patterns documented in .claude/rules/51-runtime-boundary-validation.md (CSS-var-as-number casts, third-party generic container/lib-type-gap casts, self-constructed display/log payload widening), not unaddressed debt. local-record-guard is 1 since 2026-11-12: deploy/selfhost/docker-proxy/shapes.ts isRecord, because the docker socket proxy image runs its .ts files alone under node type stripping with no workspace packages, so it cannot import the API runtime-validation helpers (#2676). Any other local record guard still fails.
